content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-d01-z11paugh/report.rdl

Clean up this report: remove the two data sources that nothing uses.
I need to check which data source DataSet1 uses before removing anything. The inventory doesn't show that, so I'll look for a dataset tool.
The search didn't turn up a data source removal tool yet. I'll search more specifically for one and for a way to read the dataset's connection.

I couldn't remove the data sources, so the report is unchanged.

The tools I have can't delete a data source. I also can't confirm which ones are unused. The report has three data sources (FleetModel, LegacySQL, ScratchPowerQuery) and one dataset (DataSet1), but the dataset tools don't show which data source DataSet1 points to. Editing the .rdl XML by hand would go beyond what these tools support, so I didn't try.

To finish this cleanup, you could do it in Report Builder or Visual Studio: open the Report Data pane, check which data source DataSet1 uses, and delete the other two. If you tell me which two are unused, I can check the remaining parts of the report, such as the FleetTable, the HoursBySite chart, and the parameters, for references to them.
